items.title: Terry Gibbs interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2001 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: a guy called Bill Carruthers, became a big producer/director with Chuck Barris, and they asked me if I would conduct the band for a show called “Operation Entertainment.”

ctx.x: Oh let me get back to that, because you asked me how I got with Steve. Then Steve asked me if I would conduct for him. And I had another show coming up. By that time I was ready to sit down and settle down. No first he asked me actually if I would go to Las Vegas with him. Because I taught Steve how to play vibes, and we used to close out the show playing the vibes. I taught him how to do that. When he’d come in the club we’d do that. So he thought it’d be good in the show. I would play a song I had written up on…
You did a lot of things, for sure.
